prompt: Round 3 of 6. The researcher side proposes (We want university ownership of results with an option for the company to licence them, as university IP ownership i

content.text:
The researcher wants uni_owns_option_to_licence instead of contract_research_company_owns. This is a significant difference - we want to own the results. However, uni_owns_option_to_assign would be better for us than uni_owns_option_to_licence, as it gives us a path to full ownership. Let me counter with uni_owns_option_to_assign and push review days back to 60 since our confidential data is at stake.

Actually, let me think about what matters most: IP ownership and publication review days. I'll trade on review days (accept 30) to get better IP terms (option_to_assign instead of option_to_licence).
